title: Materials Handling Technician
description:
Overview
As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries as instructed by management. You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Responsibilities
Customer Service

  • Maintains a strong focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks. Ensures IAM tasks are completed accurately as requested, as well as meet company and industry standards and policies. Builds strong working relationships with customers. Identifies, coordinates, manages expectations, and offers alternatives when defining stakeholder solutions in light of ongoing company standards, operations, and procedures (e.g., schedule, technical feasibility, policy, procedure, tools).

Data Bearing Device (DBD) Destruction

  • Performs destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies as necessary. Ensures DBD serial number matches with database. Coordinates with and oversees any third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary.

Inbound and Outbound Logistics

  • Coordinates, prepares, and executes incoming/outgoing deliveries (e.g. purchase order (PO) receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor (RMS) activities). Documents inbound/outbound packages. Receives, confirms, tracks, stores, dispatches, and delivers material from the warehouse to destinations, including production facilities, retail stores, and corporate offices. Applies appropriate customs documentations and standards for outbound packages. Ensures complete and detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.

Inventory Management

  • Maintains and stewards up-to-date and accurate logical information within various inventory management systems (e.g., configuration management databases, asset management repositories). Performs inventory cycle audits, data corrections, and various Data Center regulatory compliance or certification control audit activity. Performs material movement, including shipping/receiving and inventory management per standard process.

Operational Excellence

  • Follows procedures to contribute to plans to develop, build, and run methodologies. Ensures execution according to accepted procedures for consistency, accuracy, and timeliness of delivery.

Procurement

  • Notifies management about ordering stock shortages. Escalates any issues to management.

Safety Practices

  • Complies with security and data management policies. Escalates any security or safety incidents. Coordinates with security escorts for third-party vendors. Engages in Task Hazard Analysis (THA) consistently for every task to be performed and ensures sign off from appropriate person for any related risks.

Tactical Shift Management

  • Performs assigned tasks and escalates issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations. Leverages process knowledge and best judgment to complete next task without direct supervision.

Warranty Process Management

  • Engages supplier to initiate warranty claim when automation is not available and processes the orders. Processes failed vendor hardware devices using online/other tools, including information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices. Follows all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.
  • As indicated above, this role has a travel requirement of up to 25% which means you may be required to travel, from time to time, as part of this role.

Other

  • Embody our culture and values.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications

  • High School Diploma AND 1+ year(s) experience warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation OR equivalent experience.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
requesting accommodations.

Job Description

4. Auditar documentações quanto ao cumprimento das regras GMP vigentes, Guias e Politicas Corporativas;

5. Auditar documentação analítica de produtos para liberação, estabilidade, matéria prima e material de embalagem;

6. Auditar dados eletrônicos em sistemas/equipamentos de laboratório;

7. Elaborar, atualizar e revisar os SOPs em conformidade com as legislações locais e guias corporativos.

8. Elaborar e executar os protocolos e relatórios de IQ/OQ/PQ dos equipamentos do laboratório.

9.   Elaborar e executar os protocolos e relatórios de validação de metodologia analítica.

10. Comunicar e investigar qualquer resultado atípico gerado através do sistema formal de desvios.

11. Suportar e realizar a qualificação e/ou treinamento de analistas.

12. Contribuir no atendimento das métricas estabelecidas pela companhia.

13. Dar suporte à coordenação no planejamento anual e acompanhamento de despesas, elaboração de relatórios de métricas e no atendimento á auditorias internas e externas.

14. Conhecer e aplicar a regulamentações cGMP, políticas e guias. Cumprir com os requisitos cGMP descritos nas políticas e guias da empresa e na legislação pertinente. Seguir os SOPs e instruções aplicáveis. Documentar as atividades adequadamente. Utilizar os equipamentos com responsabilidade.

15. Conduzir todas as atividades do trabalho de modo seguro e ambientalmente responsável, obedecer a todos os regulamentos, políticas corporativas, procedimentos e diretrizes de segurança e meio ambiente aplicáveis, informar prontamente qualquer incidente, participar ativamente dos treinamentos necessários e das atribuições dos comitês aplicáveis e auxiliar na promoção de um ambiente de trabalho seguro.

title: Especialista de Projetos
description:
Ingersoll Rand está comprometida em promover a diversidade na força de trabalho, de forma que reflita as comunidades onde atuamos. Somos um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para vagas de emprego, independentemente de idade, ancestralidade, nacionalidade, cor, raça, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, estado civil, condição médica, deficiência física ou mental, filiação política, religião ou qualquer outra característica protegida pelas leis, regulamentos e normas aplicáveis.

Título da Vaga: Especialista de Projetos

Localização: Campinas, SP

Sobre nós

Imagine uma empresa com mais de 160 anos de liderança tecnológica, mas que opera com a energia de uma startup. A Ingersoll Rand se dedica a melhorar a vida de seus colaboradores, clientes, acionistas e do planeta. Produzimos tecnologias inovadoras e essenciais para geração de fluxo e ciências da vida – de compressores ao manuseio preciso de líquidos, gases e energias – para aumentar a produtividade industrial, a eficiência e a sustentabilidade.

Apoiados por mais de 80 marcas, nossos produtos são usados em diversos mercados finais, incluindo ciências da vida, alimentos e bebidas, energia limpa, manufatura industrial, infraestrutura e muito mais. Ao redor do mundo, impulsionamos o crescimento com espírito empreendedor e mentalidade de dono. Saiba mais em e junte-se a nós para assumir o controle do seu futuro.

Visão Geral da Vaga

Atuar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos ETO (Engineer to Order), sendo responsável pelo detalhamento técnico, suporte à fabricação, interação com clientes e fornecedores, e gestão de atividades ligadas à engenharia, produção e cronogramas, garantindo a execução eficiente e personalizada dos projetos.

Responsabilidades

  • Elaboração de desenhos de arranjo geral e detalhamento técnico para fabricação de projetos ETO, incluindo cadastro de itens ETO no SAP.
  • Planejamento e controle dos projetos ETO, com elaboração de cronogramas e databooks.
  • Participação ativa em reuniões de projetos, incluindo reuniões semanais, K.O.M. (Kick-Off Meeting) e P.I.M., com clientes e fornecedores.
  • Acompanhamento das atividades da produção/fábrica, garantindo alinhamento entre engenharia e manufatura.
  • Acompanhamento de inspeções e diligenciamentos internos e externos, com interface direta junto aos clientes.
  • Interface técnica com fornecedores de equipamentos, caldeiraria e instrumentação, bem como interação com os departamentos de Vendas e Assistência Técnica.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia;
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita;
  • Experiência com Inventor e AutoCAD;
  • Experiência na área de projetos mecânicos, elétricos ou automação;
  • Experiência técnica em detalhamento de tubulações, caldeiraria, tanque separadores de líquidos, layout, estruturas para bases / skids e P&D de processo ETO;
  • Conhecimento das Normas: NR12, NR13, ANSI, ISO e DIN;
  • Desejável experiência com equipamentos rotatívos industriais.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em bombas de vácuo e compressores de ar;
  • Experiência em Off Shore e sistemas de Oil&gás;
  • Desejável conhecimento em MS Project;
  • Desejável conhecimento em POWER BI.

Viagens e Modalidade de Trabalho

  • Disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas, conforme necessidade dos projetos.
  • Modelo híbrido: 1 dia de home office na semana

title: Veterinário Atendente
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.

Location: Paulínia (SP)

Position Summary:
Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.

Responsibilities:

  • In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.
  • Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.
  • Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.
  • In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.
  • Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.
  • Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.
  • Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.
  • Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.
  • Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.
  • Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.
  • Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.
  • Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.
  • Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.
  • As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.
  • Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.
  • Previous technical experience with the facility's working species—poultry and rodents—is desirable.
  • Solidf experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A master's or phD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.
  • Planning and organizational skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a team
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles
  • Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments
  • In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations
  • Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.
  • Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.
  • The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on-call schedules and veterinary occurrences.
  • The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.

  • Facilitar a Extração de Conteúdo: Atuar junto aos especialistas (conteudistas) para estruturar o conhecimento bruto, ajudando na definição de objetivos de aprendizagem e na roteirização (storyboarding) de conteúdos.
  • Articular a Interface Técnica: Traduzir as necessidades pedagógicas para os designers e programadores, criando especificações técnicas detalhadas para evitar retrabalho e garantir a usabilidade dos materiais.
  • Analisar e Revisar Materiais: Realizar a revisão técnica e pedagógica de todos os entregáveis (protótipos e versões finais), garantindo a fidelidade ao conteúdo original, a correção gramatical e a aderência à identidade visual da marca.
  • Homologar Conteúdos no LMS: Testar e validar a funcionalidade de conteúdos digitais dentro das plataformas de gestão de aprendizagem (LMS), garantindo a correta extração de dados e relatórios de conclusão.

  • Monitorar Indicadores de Produção: Gerenciar KPIs de produção (tempo médio de desenvolvimento, custo por hora de treinamento produzido, taxa de aprovação na primeira versão) para reportar a eficiência da área de conteúdo.

  • Gestão de Projetos de Educação Corporativa: Experiência comprovada no gerenciamento do ciclo de vida de projetos de T&D, preferencialmente em academias de treinamento de grandes indústrias ou setores de alta complexidade técnica (ex: automotivo, maquinário, tecnologia).
  • Interface entre Áreas Técnicas e Criativas: Histórico de atuação como elo entre especialistas de negócio (SMEs) e times de produção (designers, editores e desenvolvedores), garantindo que o conhecimento técnico seja traduzido em linguagem instrucional.

# 1231 Supervisor(a) de Apoio em Saúde

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Supervisionar, planejar, organizar e acompanhar as ações de apoio à saúde desenvolvidas pela ONG Associação Expedicionários da Saúde (EDS), assegurando a execução qualificada dos atendimentos assistenciais, a preparação técnica dos materiais necessários para as ações de saúde na Amazônia, o cumprimento dos protocolos institucionais e a integração entre equipes, parceiros e voluntários, bem como o apoio aos programas institucionais da EDS, garantindo a qualidade do cuidado prestado às populações atendidas, especialmente em contextos de áreas remotas, saúde indígena e operações institucionais.

Organograma Presidência Executiva → Vice-Presidência Executiva → Diretoria Executiva → Diretoria Operacional de Saúde → Coordenação Operacional de Saúde → Supervisor(a) de Apoio à Saúde → Enfermeiro(a) de Apoio à Saúde

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Supervisionar atividades assistenciais das equipes de apoio à saúde
  • Planejar fluxos de atendimento e rotinas assistenciais conforme protocolos da EDS
  • Garantir cumprimento de diretrizes técnicas e biossegurança
  • Orientar tecnicamente profissionais de enfermagem
  • Coordenar preparação de materiais, insumos e equipamentos para ações e expedições na Amazônia
  • Articular com áreas internas para organização e disponibilização de materiais
  • Apoiar programas institucionais e integração de equipes multiprofissionais
  • Manter comunicação efetiva com parceiros, voluntários e equipes
  • Monitorar registros e indicadores assistenciais
  • Comunicar demandas e oportunidades de melhoria à Coordenação
  • Participar de auditorias fornecendo suporte técnico
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre normas e boas práticas

CARACTERÍSTICAS

Autonomia técnica, foco em organização e qualificação assistencial, liderança, articulação institucional, comunicação ética e respeito à diversidade cultural.

REQUISITOS

  • Formação: Graduação em Enfermagem com COREN ativo. Desejável experiência hospitalar em clínicas cirúrgicas, CC e CME
  • Experiência: Mínimo 2 anos em atividades assistenciais com vivência em supervisão
  • Conhecimentos: Protocolos assistenciais, saúde pública, biossegurança, planejamento multiprofissional
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês
  • Competências: Liderança, organização, comunicação, empatia, responsabilidade e tomada de decisão

Plano de Saúde, Seguro de Vida, Vale alimentação, Vale transporte, Cesta básica, bônus por meta.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma organização 100% nacional, apaixonados pela criação de tecnologia brasileira e focados em soluções e inovações.

Geramos soluções em TIC's (Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação), que são aplicadas em diversos setores, como: telecom, agronegócios, financeiro, utilities, indústrias, cidades, varejo e serviços de defesa e segurança.

Acreditamos que por meio do Nosso Jeito de Ser e de Fazer, atingiremos resultados sustentáveis, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas e da sociedade.

Nossos valores definem nossa essência: quem somos, o que nos inspira e nos torna únicos. Eles são o Nosso Jeito de Ser.


Valores institucionais - COCRIAR:

Colaboração

Orientação ao cliente

Confiança

Respeito

Inovação

Agilidade

Resultado

A partir do Nosso Jeito de Ser definimos as competências e os comportamentos que refletem, na prática, o Nosso Jeito de Fazer - Liderança e Capacidade de Influência, Integração e Cooperação, Escuta Ativa, Ética e Integridade, Inteligência Emocional, Curiosidade e Aprendizado, Pensamento Digital, Pensamento Sistêmico, Resiliência e Flexibilidade, Planejamento e Gerenciamento do Tempo, Geração de Valor, Decisão com Base em Dados

Identifica-se com Nosso Jeito de Ser e de Fazer? Então venha COCRIAR com a gente integrando nosso time como (VAGA)

Requisitos da vaga

Quais serão seus desafios no dia-a-dia:

  • Realizar análises detalhadas e fornecer suporte técnico para a execução eficiente das operações da área. 

  • Contribuir para a otimização de processos e a resolução de problemas, alinhando as atividades aos objetivos operacionais da organização.

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders internos e externos para entender os objetivos de negócios e coletar requisitos.

  • Realizar análises para documentar e validar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, foco em plataformas de software em nuvem e soluções de IA.

  • Transformar requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas compreensíveis para as equipes de desenvolvimento.

  • Garantir uma compreensão clara e mútua entre as partes interessadas e a equipe de desenvolvimento.

  • Manter a documentação do produto atualizada.

  • Mapear e documentar processos de negócios, identificando áreas de melhoria e eficiência.

  • Propor soluções baseadas em análises de processos para otimizar operações.

  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e sprint para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos e expectativas.

  • Colaborar com equipes de teste para garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam aos requisitos definidos.

  • Participar de processos de validação para garantir a conformidade com as expectativas do cliente.

  • Avaliar o impacto de mudanças nos requisitos e nas funcionalidades existentes.

  • Colaborar na tomada de decisão estratégica para o negócio.

  • Ter a capacidade de sugerir novos processos do cliente.

Buscamos alguém com:

  • Experiência em levantamento e análise de requisitos de sistemas complexos.

  • Boa compreensão de conceitos de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning (como modelos preditivos, NLP, visão computacional, IA generativa, etc.).

  • Conhecimento básico de arquitetura de software, APIs e fluxos de dados.

  • Habilidade em documentar requisitos técnicos e de negócio de forma clara e estruturada (ex: user stories, diagramas UML, BPMN).

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de traduzir linguagem técnica para o negócio (e vice-versa).

  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em projetos de IA, ciência de dados ou automação inteligente.

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de prototipagem e documentação (Jira, Confluence, Miro, Figma, Lucidchart).

  • Noções de governança e ética em IA.

  • Familiaridade com APIs de IA generativa (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, etc.) ou soluções de IA aplicada a negócios.

  • Experiência com definição de métricas e KPIs para projetos de IA.

O CPQD oferece:

  • Auxílio creche ou babá;

  • Assistência médica Unimed;

  • Assistência odontológica Uniodonto;

  • Auxílio medicamento Vidalink;

  • Seguro de vida;

  • Plano de saúde Pet;

  • Previdência Privada;

  • WellHub;

  • Fretado;

  • Estacionamento gratuito;

  • Crédito consignado;

  • Day off no mês do aniversário;

  • Emenda de feriados;

  • Empresa cidadã: licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

  • Programa de apoio à Pós-Graduação;

  • Parcerias e convênios: facilitando opções de saúde, lazer, cultura e educação;

  • Programas internos: com foco em desenvolvimento e bem estar.

Temos orgulho de quem somos e acreditamos que isso é resultado da nossa diversidade

Por isso, investimos no nosso programa de Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão: CPQD+, fortalecendo nossas práticas para equidade de oportunidades independente de raça, gênero, idade, religião, deficiência ou orientação sexual e reafirmamos nosso compromisso em potencializar as diferenças para promover um ambiente de inovação, sustentável e seguro, onde todas as pessoas possam alcançar seu pleno potencial.

Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado. 

Agir como empreendedor
Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada
Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Nosso time de Tecnologia


Muito mais do que código e sistemas — é o meio essencial que torna possível o nosso modelo único, que combina o melhor do digital com a presença física e humana. Aqui, tecnologia não é um fim em si mesma, mas a ponte entre inovação e a experiência real do cliente. Atuam lado a lado com as áreas de negócio para garantir soluções robustas, escaláveis e centradas nas pessoas, sem abrir mão de um olhar técnico e científico aprofundado em frentes como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura, cibersegurança e arquitetura. É nessa interseção entre propósito, técnica e impacto que constroem o presente e futuro.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical PlanDental Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Employment type: Full-time

Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

title: Java Developer | Senior (11489)
description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar. Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços de backend escaláveis, seguros e de alta performance para produtos de software, garantindo qualidade, segurança e ótima experiência do cliente. Atuar na solução de problemas complexos com práticas de engenharia sustentáveis (código limpo, testável e manutenível) e colaborar com times multidisciplinares para decisões técnicas e de produto.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend (APIs REST) com foco em disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança.
  • Participar de discussões de arquitetura e decisões técnicas (event-driven, hexagonal, domain-driven).
  • Implementar e manter padrões de segurança (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, mTLS, JWT).
  • Realizar code reviews e zelar por padrões de código, testes e documentação (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Monitorar e otimizar performance (profiling, tuning de queries, caching, concorrência).
  • Instrumentar observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing distribuído) e responder a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com Produto, QA, SRE/Cloud e Suporte; antecipar riscos e propor mitigação.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, apoiando desenvolvedores menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência sólida em backend com Java (preferencialmente 17+), POO e princípios SOLID.
  • Spring Boot e arquitetura hexagonal; conhecimento de event-driven (ex.: SNS/SQS, eventos de domínio).
  • APIs RESTful e documentação OpenAPI (Swagger).
  • Maven (ou Gradle) para build e gestão de dependências.
  • AWS: uso prático de SNS, SQS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ECR e DocumentDB/MongoDB.
  • Docker/docker-compose e noções de Kubernetes (manifests básicos, deployments, services, troubleshooting com kubectl).
  • Observabilidade: logs, métricas e tracing (conceitos).
  • Bancos relacionais e não relacionais; modelagem e domínio de queries.
  • CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (branching, pipelines, PRs, feature flags).
  • Segurança de aplicações: OWASP (ASVS/Top 10), JWT/JWS, mTLS, boas práticas de secrets.
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.
  • Identidade & Segurança: experiência com Identity & Access Management (Keycloak ou equivalente) e implementação de OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect em produção.

Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Profundidade em Keycloak (realms, clients, policies, mappers) e OAuth 2.0 (grants, PAR, JAR, DCR).
  • Observabilidade avançada: Prometheus, Grafana e OpenTelemetry (traces e métricas end-to-end).
  • Performance & escalabilidade: baixa latência/alta concorrência (profilers, k6/JMeter, tuning de JVM).
  • Helm e Infra as Code (Terraform) para padronização de deploys.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript para manutenção de mocks de testes/interceptors.
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, eventos ou projetos open source.
  • Liderança técnica (guildas, chapters, definição de padrões, mentoria).

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.
  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade, tudo bem? =)

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with the managers, directors and technical leaders of our organization to elevate our architecture practices to the next level;
  • Collaborate and support the technical leaders in making technical decisions following our standards and guardrails/guidelines;
  • Help other teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical debts and bugs;
  • Foster adoption of best coding practices and patterns;
  • Write technical documentation (with charts, data points and diagrams) and present technical solutions to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner;
  • Help create the architecture principles and present to different stakeholders (e.g.: managers, technical leaders, directors, product managers);

  • Assist in the career development of other developers by providing technical mentoring, pair programming and/or reviewing PRs;
  • Actively contribute to our Backend community by planning, executing and presenting in our Backend Guild sharing technical knowledge;
  • Facilitate communication and alignment of technical backlogs between squads.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field OR relevant time Software Engineering work experience;
  • Solid fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving;
  • Expertise in at least one programming language and its main frameworks;
  • Experience in Systems Architectural styles (Monolith, Plugin, SOA, Microservices, Event-driven);
  • Knowledge of Architecture concepts (Software design, hexagonal architecture, onion, clean architecture);
  • Experience with APIs and capabilities;
  • Experience in leading the deployment of systems into production;
  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms and main providers;
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) Technologies;
  • Experience in System Modeling (desirable experience in tactical DDD);
  • Familiarity with Monitoring Tools, Metrics, and Observability;
  • Experience with Agile Framework;
  • Understanding of DevOps culture, automation (CI/CD), and main tools;
  • Knowledge of Quality practices (stress tests, load, TDD, BDD);
  • Advanced level of english.

More about you

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Sobre a oportunidade:

Como uma pessoa Gerente Tributária - Preços de Transferência você será parte da área de Tax atuando com foco em TP (Preços de Transferência) e apoiando na definição de preços dos produtos produzidos no exterior e vendidos no Brasil. Prestará assessoria tributária para atendimento às regras de preços de transferência realizando revisão, documentação, gerenciamento e defesa das políticas de TP, além da preparação de cálculos e documentos pertinentes para o cumprimento de obrigações principais e acessórias.

Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e realizar análises de preços de transferência sob a ótica das diretrizes da OCDE;
  • Liderar e coordenar projetos globais ou regionais de documentação de preços de transferência envolvendo diversas jurisdições (CbCR, Master File, Local File e Benchmark);
  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar políticas de preços de transferência para empresas multinacionais brasileiras e internacionais;
  • Atuar em projetos de auditoria e due diligence para realizar revisões sob a ótica de preços de transferência;
  • Desenvolver a equipe nas melhores práticas de preços de transferência;
  • Auxiliar nos processos de auditoria de preços de transferência de clientes;
  • Participar de processos de procedimento amigável e acordos antecipados de preços;
  • Efetuar diagnóstico das operações sujeitas às regras de preços de transferência e métodos aplicáveis, realizando business modelings quando necessário;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento de trabalho produtivo com os profissionais dos clientes e avaliar a satisfação dos serviços prestados;
  • Entender as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços que podemos oferecer aos nossos clientes.

Requisitos e habilidades que buscamos:

  • Experiência na área de preços de transferência (in house ou Big4);
  • Graduação em economia, contabilidade ou administração;
  • Mestrado em administração, finanças ou áreas correlatas (desejável);
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente;
  • Espanhol desejável;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita.

Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

O que oferecemos:

Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas.

Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Na Swarovski, onde a inovação se encontra com a inspiração, nosso pessoal de caixa são os nossos defensores, que prestam aos clientes um serviço extraordinário e uma experiência de marca inspiradora.

Responsável por auxiliar o gerente de boutique em todas as tarefas administrativas respeitando a abordagem e estratégia empresarial para atingir objetivos de desempenho definidos em termos de vendas, bem como os objetivos qualitativos, incluindo a qualidade do serviço e aparência da boutique de acordo com a estratégia e política da Swarovski.

Sobre o cargo

Você é defensor(a) da nossa marca. Nesta função, e juntamente com a equipa, irá:

  • Realizar as tarefas de Contabilidade, emissão de NF série 01e D1 e enviar os documentos fiscais ao escritório/ Pryor (NF´s , leitura X e leitura z) a fim de garantir o funcionamento dos procedimentos fiscais na boutique.

  • Informar através do email e fax, a chegada de boletos bancários na boutique, e enviar posteriormente ao setor de contas as pagar.
  • Outras tarefas de rotina da área

Sobre você

Você é Um(a) Pessoa De Caixa Excecional, Que Nos Oferece

  • um excelente sentido de moda e uma verdadeira paixão pela nossa marca e os nossos produtos;
  • experiência/forte interesse nas marcas de moda/cosmética/estilo de vida de luxo;
  • uma personalidade fortemente motivada e focada na orientação do cliente;
  • dedicação e atitude orientada por objetivos;

  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Licença para voluntario
  • Programas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento

Sobre a Swarovski

A Swarovski produz produtos à base de cristal de qualidade e habilidade artística impecáveis que trazem alegria e celebram a individualidade. Fundada em 1895 na Áustria, a empresa desenha, fabrica e vende sofisticados cristais, pedras preciosas, diamantes e zircônias fabricadas e acessórios, bem como objetos de cristal e acessórios para a casa. A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Oferemos à nossa equipe a coragem de celebrar a individualidade e o orgulho de criar um local de trabalho onde as pessoas se sintam envolvidas, respeitadas, valorizadas, conectadas e ouvidas. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. Não discriminamos com base em raça, cor, religião, estado civil, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência física ou mental, condição médica, gravidez, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei nos países onde operamos.

description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Human Resources Services

  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento e operação de playbooks no FortiSOAR ;
  • Domínio das ferramentas Fortinet: FortiSOAR, FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate, FortiMail, FortiWeb ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Threat Intelligence, IOC Enrichment, STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT&CK, YARA ;
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica, preferencialmente no setor elétrico (diferencial altamente valorizado);

description:
Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE)

Join to apply for the Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE) role at Microsoft Power Platform Community

Business Function Overview

In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. As a CO+I CE Field Service Engineer, you will deliver core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Responsibilities

  • Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
  • Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
  • Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
  • Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters.
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year.
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives.
  • Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters.
  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed.
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring.
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs).
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio.
  • Hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
  • Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility.
  • OR 3+ years industry experience and college course work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services.
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects.
  • Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.).

Background Check Requirements

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Equal Opportunity
